prompt: A person sits on a chair and eats soup with a spoon, repeatedly bringing the right hand up to the mouth.
A person stands still, raises the right hand to chest height to look at a phone, and stares down at it.
A person runs forward in a hurry.
A person sits holding a steering wheel with the left hand, reaches the right hand forward to turn a key, then freezes and turns the head to the left.
A person stands bending forward with both hands resting on a low edge in front, watching it and shifting weight impatiently.
A person crouches down, grabs a cord with the right hand and pulls it back hard, then stays crouched.
A person stands still and slowly turns the head to the left with a worried, tense posture.
A person stands with both hands on the hips and shakes the head in disapproval.
A person walks forward slowly, pushing a heavy gate with both hands at chest height.
A person leans slightly forward and uses both hands at waist height to close a padlock.
A person sits at a table leaning forward and writes on paper with the right hand.
A person stands relaxed with arms hanging by the sides, breathing calmly and looking ahead.
A person standing still suddenly turns the head and upper body to the right, startled.
A person stands hunched like a zombie with arms hanging limply, swaying, then slowly turns the head to the left.
A person walks forward very slowly like a zombie, dragging the left foot, body leaning, the left arm reaching forward.
